about: Sequence patterns: how to make a sequence, as an ordered list of beats the strategy compiler can expand. Each beat is a slot (rung, time, duration band, cut in, what it does), not a shot; the compiler fills it from cameras.json for the site's own moments. 'from' names the director row the pattern comes from; 'used_in' names where the Stonehenge script already does it.

the_proof.what: A measured claim shown so it cannot be doubted: establish from above, the same frame on the other days, then on the line, the instant held, release along the line.

beats.does: overhead: the shadows lie along the line
contrast: the same frame at the same Sun height on the other important days
on the line, long lens: the body enters the frame the stones make
the window: the body inside one gap
the instant held, the camera moves along the line

the_proof.used_in: script v3.1 act VI (shots 8, 8c, 9, 10, 11) and act VIII (14, 14c, 15, 16)

the_approach.what: A thing appears small on the horizon and grows for a long time; the viewer earns the arrival.

beats.does: the walk or dolly in, the subject small at first
the subject fills the frame; the move continues

the_approach.used_in: 6_walk_in; the Heel Stone from down the Avenue (not yet made)

the_jump.what: From the extreme wide straight to the extreme close, nothing between; the scale shock.

beats.does: the Plain or the overhead
one edge of one stone, or the Sun's disc alone

the_jump.used_in: not yet; a candidate for the first seconds after the dissolve into 'the year'

the_pillow.what: A short still shot of place between two acts; nothing happens; the film breathes.

beats.does: a lintel, the Heel Stone alone, the ditch; locked, no event

the_pillow.used_in: not yet; between acts II/III and VII/VIII

the_breath.what: After the climax, the frame stays after the event has left it; then the cut.

beats.does: the same frame as the climax, the body gone, the stones remain

the_breath.used_in: A_spring_rise to black (the coda); the end of V_slot wants it

the_match.what: Two moments far apart in time, the same lens and mirrored camera, cut directly; the viewer sees the symmetry without being told.

beats.does: on the line from one end, the body in the gap
on the line from the other end, the same lens, the body in the same gap

the_match.used_in: A_summer_sw to A_winter_ne; A_axis_5s to A_axis_5s_winter (the compare clip)

the_look.what: Show where the eye is, then what it sees: the point of interest of the second shot sits where the first left it.

beats.does: the line seen from above, the body at frame centre
along the line at eye height, the body at frame centre

the_look.used_in: A_summer_top to A_summer_sw (the eye-trace rule in the grammar)

the_montage_of_place.what: Equal shots of one place through time, music-led, no story but the light; the scale ladder descends across the set.

beats.does: the Plain
the circle from above
the stones at eye height
one stone, the light moving on it

the_montage_of_place.used_in: acts I and II (V_plain, V_carr, V_sundial) in spirit

the_long_take.what: One shot that carries a whole act; time itself is the subject; the camera drifts so slowly the move is noticed only at the end.

beats.does: the dawn from first light to the whole disc, one drift along the line

the_long_take.used_in: not yet; a candidate to replace shots 9 and 10 with one shot

the_reveal.what: The subject withheld, then disclosed by the camera's own move: rise behind a stone and the whole axis appears.

beats.does: behind the trilithon, the view blocked
the crane up and tilt down: the line to the Heel Stone and the Avenue

the_reveal.used_in: axis_crane_up in the camera library; 8_alignment in spirit
